# EOC - Executive Operations Center
# EOC 3.9 GA - Build 339
Command-First Decisions and Background Test Ownership.
- Leads with the conclusion, one next instruction, and the primary action. - Keeps technical evidence behind exact-case Deep Dive controls. - One verification request is retained and completed by EOC through its existing bounded scan. - Returns the result automatically through notification, Logbook, and retained UI state. - Adds no new watcher, timer, gameplay, or automation authority.
Runtime accepted by RazorEQX. Compatible with X4 8.x and 9.x.
